text:
anya: Heads-up — onboarding optoral-13b-v2. Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/optoral/13b/v2/ (sha a1b2c3). I hit a tokenizer quirk when running the HF tokenizer: EOS sometimes duplicates when `add_prefix_space=false` on some inputs. Asking for a quick config sanity check before I open the PR for serving.
anya: Current proposed serving config (draft):
```yaml
model: optoral-13b-v2
quantization: q4_0
continuous_batcher:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  max_batch_size: 16
  batch_wait_ms: 12
caching:
  prefix_cache: true
  kv_ttl_seconds: 300
scheduler:
  per_gpu_slots: 4
  preemption: false
max_request_tokens: 8192
```
anya: Also planning a canary 5% -> 25% over 24h if configs look good.
sam: quick :eyes: overall looks reasonable. a couple qs:
- are you planning sharded KV cache or per-model cache? that affects memory.
- quantization + max_request_tokens 8192 might push VRAM depending on sequence lengths.
mike: re: tokenizer — can you point to the exact tokenizer file you used? my guess is the `tokenizer.json` vs HF `tokenizer_config.json` mismatch. try with `add_prefix_space=true` which often fixes leading-space eos duplication.
mike: quick repro you can run locally:
```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('s3://redwood-models/optoral/13b/v2/tokenizer')
print(t.encode("Hello world"))
print(t.encode("Hello world\n"))
# toggle add_prefix_space
```
kevin: watch out: 16 * 4096 tokens = 65k tokens in batch. With q4_0 that's not free. If each token KV cache entry is ~1.5KB (worst case) we could OOM on 80GB GPUs. Suggest either lower max_batch_size to 8 or enable streaming KV eviction (or bump per_gpu_slots to 6 to reduce concurrent batches).
kevin: alternative: keep max_batch_tokens=4096 but set `max_batch_size: 8` and `batch_wait_ms: 8` to keep latency tight while reducing memory spikes.
anya: good catch — we should be conservative for initial rollout. I'll change max_batch_size to 8 and batch_wait_ms to 8 in the PR. For caching I'll start with per-model cache (simpler) and note follow-up to test sharded cache.
ops-bot: deploy-preview created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/4823 (anya) — CI: unit tests queued.
mike: pls add a small unit test that feeds the tokenizer edgecases (trailing newline, leading space, empty string) and asserts no duplicated EOS. I can add the test skeleton in the PR review.
sam: +1 to canary plan: 5% for 6h, check latency/cost/regressions, then 25% for 18h. If regressions found revert to fallback model variant (optoral-13b-v1) automatically (we have fallback policy in router).
anya: will add router fallback config and canary windows in the PR description. Also adding note: disable auto-quantize in model store for now (we want deterministic kernels for first pass).
kevin: I can review the PR tonight and check memory math against 80/96GB GPUs. mike, can you drop the tokenizer test commit to the branch and ping me?
mike: on it. sending small patch in 15m.
anya: awesome — thanks team. I'll update the config and open PR (link posted by ops-bot). ping me if you spot anything else before I merge. :thumbsup:
